name: casehatch
description: Source-grounded behavior checks before you push. Local, deterministic Playwright replay for your coding agent.
author: Omkar Ghugarkar

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run demo
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts integrations schemas README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md docs/CLI.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md docs/STATUS.md docs/VALIDATION.md examples/demo .github/workflows package.json tsconfig*.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts integrations schemas README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md docs/CLI.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md docs/STATUS.md docs/VALIDATION.md examples/demo .github/workflows package.json tsconfig*.json
